description: Aider-polyglot style (Java), built for the repair round: convert between spreadsheet column numbers and labels (A, Z, AA, AZ, ZZ, AAA). The natural first implementation uses ordinary base-26 with n % 26 and so gets the multiples of 26 wrong (26 becomes A@ or AZ, 52 and 702 break) because the numbering has no zero digit, and it often forgets the int overflow check in fromLabel; the tests catch both, so the post-turn verifier's second round has to fix them. A protected run_tests.py compiles with javac and runs a plain Java test runner.
